operating_mode_addendum: v2.6 — Manual On-Demand Drafting Mode (operating mode only; adds NO content gate). Engine is 2.7; runs pass policy_version=2.7.
validator_engine_note: outreach/preflight.py POLICY_VERSION is now 2.7 (Artifact Readback Integrity, built on 2.6 Geography & Scope). Runs pass policy_version="2.7" to preflight(). v2.7 adds check_readback_artifact(stored_plaintext, expected_price, html_supplied) — a MANDATORY post-creation gate on the plaintext body read back from Gmail: a google.com/url wrapper in the stored plaintext is READBACK_ARTIFACT_DEFECT when html_supplied=False (the recipient would see the raw wrapper); it is tolerated only when html_supplied=True AND the wrapper carries q=https to the canonical domain. q=http downgrades and a missing canonical domain still fail, the resolved postal footer + opt-out line must be present, and stored $ amounts must equal the selected offer's price. It also hardens check_offer_and_price: a lone $ amount must match the configured offer price even when optional_price is unset. Traces to a real repeated escape found 2026-07-02: batch20/21 drafts (and at least one SENT message) showed the raw google.com/url?q=https wrapper as the visible Website line; the old readback check passed it because it only rejected q=http. 170 regression tests green.
v2_5_note: Human Voice & Conversational Credibility. A longer AI email is still an AI email; v2.5 attacks the *voice*, not just word count. New per-draft gates (preflight.py): check_abstract_language (ABSTRACT_LANGUAGE_OVERUSE), check_ai_phrase_patterns (AI_PHRASE_PATTERN), check_modal_overuse (MODAL_VERB_OVERUSE), check_personalization_depth (PERSONALIZATION_FACT_ONLY), check_brand_noun_removal (GENERIC_WITH_SPECIFIC_NOUNS), check_mini_proposal (MINI_PROPOSAL_OVERBUILT), check_excessive_listing (EXCESSIVE_LISTING), check_read_aloud (SENTENCE_RHYTHM_ARTIFICIAL), check_credibility_boilerplate (CREDIBILITY_BOILERPLATE), check_cta_generic (CTA_GENERIC), check_human_voice (HUMAN_VOICE_LOW). New batch gate batch_voice_preflight() (separate from batch_preflight): BATCH_PARAGRAPH_PATTERN, BATCH_CREDIBILITY_PATTERN, BATCH_STRUCTURE_CONCENTRATION, BATCH_MODAL_PATTERN, BATCH_PERSONALIZATION_SHALLOW, BATCH_PUNCTUATION_PATTERN, BATCH_AI_VOICE_CONCENTRATION. A draft must pass preflight() AND batch_preflight() AND batch_voice_preflight(). Personalization-by-thought (why_this_idea / human_reaction / prospect_specific_connection) is required, not just personalization-by-fact. Distinguish personalized information from personalized writing from personalized intent. Document the principle, not the exact phrase list — do not overfit thresholds to one batch.
batch_preflight_note: v2.4: a draft must pass BOTH the per-draft preflight() AND the batch-level batch_preflight() (run over the whole authorized batch) before it may be created/updated in Gmail. The batch stage catches what individual checks miss: an email can pass alone while the batch reads automated (same subject shapes, same CTA, same positioning, recurring filler phrases, near-duplicate bodies).

human_voice_thresholds.thresholds_note: Heuristics, not a static blacklist. Tuned to flag clear AI cadence without overfitting one batch. Signature, footer, and the standardized price quote are exempt. A longer email is not automatically better; reasoning that earns the length is what matters.

v2_4_note: Humanization, Batch Diversity & Offer Fit. Traces to the 2026-06-20 20-draft batch: individual emails passed while the batch looked automated (repeated subject shapes, near-identical CTAs/positioning, recurring filler 'a natural fit'/'a good moment'/'could carry', maturity speculation, template criticism, an offer contradicting an existing asset, possible stale seasonal premises, a first name on a generic inbox, product-film positioning for non-product prospects). New per-draft gates: check_negative_framing (NEGATIVE_FRAMING), check_business_inference (UNSUPPORTED_INFERENCE), check_existing_asset (PROPOSED_ASSET_ALREADY_EXISTS), check_currentness (STALE_OPPORTUNITY/PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE/PROMOTION_ENDED/CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIED), check_offer_fit (OFFER_MISMATCH). New batch gate: batch_preflight() with BATCH_* codes. New DraftModel fields: prospect_kind, existing_assets, proposed_asset, currentness_status, reframed_as_evergreen, product_availability, promotion_status, seasonal_relevance, verified_current_date.

batch_diversity_thresholds.thresholds_note: For an ~20-draft batch: >25% of subjects sharing 'on film'/'in motion'/'page' FAIL; a single templated subject shape shared by >4 FAIL; exact CTA or exact positioning sentence repeated >4 FAIL; a tracked filler phrase or any identical 5-word shingle in >25% of bodies FAIL; body-pair 4-word-shingle Jaccard >=0.5 FAIL. Canonical signature, compliance footer, and the standardized price quote ($399/$699) are exempt from repetition analysis (commercial boilerplate).

offer_fit_note: Positioning must match BOTH the selected offer and the prospect type. Never call an architecture/lighting, design-studio, photography, or other service-brand film a 'product film' (use 'brand'/'capability' film). Do not advertise 'launch systems' in a single Product Film pitch (the canonical signature's 'Launch Systems' line is exempt — it is the studio's standing disciplines, checked separately).
claim_scope_note: v2.3.1: a limited review must produce a limited claim. The scope-aware validator (preflight.py:check_claim_scope/scope_violations) fails an ABSOLUTE absence claim ('no page of its own', 'no film for the line', 'carried entirely by still photography', 'nowhere') unless the draft records matching evidence: site-wide absence needs CHECKED_RELEVANT_SITE_ROUTES+; cross-channel/'only/entirely' absence needs VERIFIED_CROSS_CHANNEL (2+ channels_checked). Page-scoped phrasing ('I didn't see X on that page', 'currently led by', 'mentioned briefly on the homepage') is preferred and passes at OBSERVED_ON_PAGE. DraftModel adds: observation_scope, pages_checked, channels_checked, absence_claim, absence_evidence_level, approved_claim_wording.
run_size_note: default_drafts_per_run=1; max_drafts_per_run=2 only when Charles explicitly authorizes a batch; never infer a larger batch. DRAFT_ONLY: these caps govern draft creation + manual-send records, NOT automatic sending. Caps are conservative quality/reputation controls, not a way to bypass spam filtering. NOTE: default/max_drafts_per_run and the per-day/week caps govern run_mode=SCHEDULED only; a Charles-initiated run_mode=MANUAL run (see manual_on_demand_mode) is exempt from run-size/slot/weekend/weekly caps but NOT from any quality/integrity gate.

manual_on_demand_mode.trigger: Charles asks in-session for outreach drafts (e.g. 'draft N emails', 'do an outreach batch'). Distinct from the autonomous scheduled routine; does NOT count as breaking its cadence or sent-message ramp.
manual_on_demand_mode.requested_n_is: a CEILING, not a quota. Deliver the true number that genuinely passes, up to N, and report the honest count. Fewer than N (or zero) when no further prospect clears the bar is a successful, compliant run. Never weaken a gate, fabricate a trigger, guess an email, reuse a domain inside 90 days, or widen geography the user did not authorize to reach N.
manual_on_demand_mode.accounting: Manual drafts are tracked as manual_override drafts (mirroring replacement_drafts). They do NOT change config defaults, program_start_date, the deterministic business-day index, or the next SCHEDULED run's entitlement. Log one MANUAL_OVERRIDE_BATCH summary row per run (operating policy version + business-day index + requested_n + delivered_n + rejected/held with reasons).
manual_on_demand_mode.drafts_per_run_cap_note: null = no fixed numeric cap in MANUAL mode; the binding limit is how many prospects genuinely pass every gate, bounded above by Charles's requested N.

length_principle_note: v2.5: prefer 90-125, hard 75-140. Do NOT pad to hit a number; do NOT fail a strong 82-word email for being under 90. DO fail an email that is short because it omits the reasoning that makes the idea credible (PERSONALIZATION_FACT_ONLY / BODY_TOO_SHORT).
diagnosis_rule_note: max_diagnosis_sentences=1 and idea_and_next_step_min_ratio=0.7 are the STRICTER EDITORIAL bar (tone-guide.md / SKILL.md Step 7): at most ONE friction/criticism sentence, and >=70% of the email on the idea + easy next step. They are NOT read by the engine. The deterministic gate preflight.py:check_diagnosis_ratio is a looser structural FLOOR — observation+interpretation <= 2 compact sentences (1 neutral recognition + 1 interpretation, per the three-layer model) and idea-side words must exceed diagnosis words (>50%). The editorial rule is stricter and wins on conflict; the engine gate is only a backstop. Hard-enforcing 1 sentence / 0.7 in the engine would be a deliberate engine change (update check_diagnosis_ratio + tests + bump engine version) and is NOT yet applied — flagged for Charles.
quality_score_note: v2.4: the Draft Quality Score keeps its per-draft categories AND adds batch-aware categories scored over the whole authorized batch. A high INDIVIDUAL score cannot override a FAILED batch_preflight — both gates bind. Do not inflate scores.
automatic_failure_conditions: Wrong or uncertain greeting (a specific first name on a general inbox without a packet justification)
Unsupported conversion or attention claim (no direct evidence/data)
Material contradiction with an official source not reflected in the thesis
Broken or redirected signature link (e.g. google.com/url?... or http:// instead of https://)
Product/service cannot currently support the proposed customer action (CTA)
Generic or systematically repeated subject pattern (e.g. 'A [deliverable] for [product]')
signature_renderer: outreach/preflight.py:render_signature() — the ONLY approved signature; do not improvise

signature_note: v2.6.1: the canonical signature is Charles's own template rendered by preflight.py:render_signature() — a leading '--' delimiter, then name / 'Founder, MotionX' / disciplines / 'Website: https://madebymotionx.com' / 'Email Address: charles@madebymotionx.com'. The Website line keeps the full https:// scheme. NO 'Available Worldwide', NO 'Based in', NO social links. Insert it after the body, then the compliance footer. v2.7: after creation, the stored plaintext must pass check_readback_artifact() — the google.com/url wrapper must NOT appear as visible plaintext.
link_policy: Canonicalize every MOTIONX website reference to display 'madebymotionx.com' / destination 'https://madebymotionx.com'. Pass it via an htmlBody https anchor so Gmail keeps q=https. KNOWN LIMITATION: Gmail auto-wraps ALL draft links in a google.com/url?q=...&source=gmail redirect (verified, unavoidable via the connector); the validator enforces a clean https link at the render layer, and the Gmail-readback check fails only on a q=http downgrade or wrong domain. A bare plaintext URL downgrades to q=http, so never rely on plaintext for the link.
footer_format:
MOTIONX · {{MOTIONX_POSTAL_ADDRESS}}
Not relevant? Reply "no thanks" and I won't follow up.
notes: v2.3 'Draft Reliability & Deliverability Upgrade' adds a deterministic central renderer+validator (outreach/preflight.py) with a single canonical signature, URL canonicalization (https; Gmail's google.com/url?q=https wrapper is an accepted transport artifact), a recipient-certainty engine, a medical/regulated-claim guard, a free-work-CTA guard, an AI/literary-language gate, a structured diagnosis-ratio rule, one-offer/one-price + word-count + subject gates, a centralized preflight() returning PASS/FAIL + failure codes, state-transition protection (draft never writes sent/contacted/follow_up), and run-size config (default 1 / max 2 drafts per run). Regression tests: outreach/tests/test_preflight.py (55 cases). Max 3 editorial revision attempts then reject/report. CONNECTOR LIMITATION: the Gmail connector has create/list/get/label only — NO update/delete-draft — so revising a draft means creating a new one and flagging the old for manual deletion. --- v2.2 quality patch (still in force; supersedes v2.1's length/score rules; all other v2.1 reliability rules stand). The first two real drafts (Lumen Aesthetics, Aster Parfum) were too long, too diagnostic, too literary, and over-scored. v2.2 separates RESEARCH DEPTH from EMAIL LENGTH: the packet stays detailed, the email does not repeat the thesis. Email = one observation + one concise interpretation + one tailored idea + one MOTIONX sentence + one easy question; preferred 65-110 words (allowed 55-125). New mandatory gates: site-wide contradiction check (inspect homepage + service/product pages + nav + sitemap + booking dest + campaign pages + social BEFORE claiming any absence; add dossier section 'Contradictory or qualifying evidence found elsewhere on the official site'); recipient-certainty gate (no specific first name on a general inbox like info@/hello@/experience@ without packet justification — use 'Hi [Brand] team,' or 'Hi [Name] and team,'); recipient-empathy editor (a SEPARATE skeptical-founder editorial pass, not the research writer); plain-language gate (no ad-copy metaphors, <=1 restrained visual phrase, avoid multiple em dashes, must read in one pass); diagnosis limited to <=1 sentence with >=70% of the email on idea + next step; commercial-readiness check (the proposed CTA must be currently possible); price language uses 'my pilot rate for this is $X' and price is optional with a packet rationale; clean plain-text signature (no repeated email line, no 'Website:', https://madebymotionx.com only, no google.com/url redirects); compact footer ('MOTIONX · <address>' + 'Not relevant? Reply "no thanks" and I won't follow up.'); subject 2-5 words, reject repeated 'A [deliverable] for [product]' patterns (check last 10). New binding gate: Draft Quality Score >= 9 (factual precision 0-2, recipient fit 0-2, naturalness 0-2, respectfulness 0-2, clarity/compression 0-1, link/signature readiness 0-1) with automatic-failure conditions that fail regardless of total; the research agent may not be the sole final scorer. Phone-screen test before drafting. PRESERVED unchanged: TEST mode, DRAFT_ONLY, all caps, one-follow-up maximum, 90-day same-domain rule, CRM/suppression/outcome-log/business-day state, Gmail labels, research framework, scheduled tasks. crm_dir is OUTSIDE the git repo; never commit CRM data or the postal address. SKILL.md is authoritative; on conflict use the stricter rule.

continuous_improvement.name: Continuous Improvement Loop
continuous_improvement.note: Operating-mode addendum only; adds NO content gate. The validator engine has since moved to 2.7 (see validator_engine_note); runs pass policy_version=2.7; 170 tests green. Every drafting run ends by running the loop in outreach/self-improvement.md: measure iterations + recurring failure codes + integrity near-misses, make the smallest safe improvement (authoring heuristic, authoring_lint.py tweak, or SKILL clarification), and log it to ~/.motionx-outreach/improvement-log.md. Never weaken a gate to look better; every change traces to a real failure or near-miss.
continuous_improvement.running_log: ~/.motionx-outreach/improvement-log.md (OUTSIDE repo; may contain PII; never commit)
continuous_improvement.rule: A heuristic/tooling change must trace to a real observed failure or near-miss; additive and reversible by default; engine changes require green tests.

v2_6_engine_note: v2.6 Geography & Scope Integrity (engine). New DraftModel fields prospect_country (default US) + geography_evidence. check_geography fails GEOGRAPHY_OUT_OF_SCOPE unless the country normalizes to the US or context[geography_authorized]=True. Currency/region settings do NOT prove US; a blank country fails closed. Traces to the batch7 Victory Barber (Victoria BC) escape.
